hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *"portal-api/index.ts"* || "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *"assets/app.js"* ]]; then echo '⚠️  Core file edited. Remember to run /ship when the feature is done.'; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; CODE="assets/app.js supabase/functions/portal-api/index.ts"; U=$(git status --porcelain -- $CODE 2>/dev/null); C=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- $CODE 2>/dev/null); D=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- docs/ 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$U" ]; then echo "REMINDER: uncommitted changes in a core file — run /ship before closing."; elif [ -n "$C" ] && { [ -z "$D" ] || [ "$C" -gt "$D" ]; }; then echo "REMINDER: core code changed after the last docs commit — run /ship before closing."; fi
